sides.name: Parthian Empire (Surena)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. 10,000 cavalry (Plutarch, accepted by most modern historians): 1,000 cataphracts, 9,000 horse archers, plus ~1,000 camels carrying arrow resupply (logistics, not a combat role). Weapons 3.3: composite bow with continuous resupply, kontos. Ships 2.0: no navy. Command 0.9: Surena. Training 0.85: Surena's household retainers. Surprise: Surena concealed his strength and armor behind a screen.

sides.name: Roman Republic (Crassus)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. 42,000: seven legions (34,000 nominal; 28,000 if understrength), 4,000 light infantry, 4,000 cavalry incl. Publius Crassus's 1,000 Gauls (heavy). Command 0.3: Crassus marched into open country without scouts on Ariamnes' advice. Morale 0.45: thirst, heat, Publius's death. Terrain: open semi-arid plain south of Harran (steppe class; summer heat and lack of water were decisive).

outcome.note: Parthian victory. Roman losses 20,000 killed + 10,000 captured (Plutarch, accepted in broad terms by moderns), 5,000-10,000 escaped; a large share fell during the night retreat to Carrhae and the following 1-2 days (Crassus killed at a parley), hence high duration 3. Parthian losses unknown but minimal: educated guess, grade D. Exact battlefield unknown; location is south of Harran with a wide radius.
